\section{Development grid of frozen \vq{8}}\label{app:q8dev}
\textbf{Development data only.} Every set below was spent before \vq{8} was written, and \vq{8} was tuned on them, set~H (\vq{7}'s fresh synthetic held-out set, corp\_fin, invoices and public\_stats 06--08) included. Frozen \vq{8} was run on every (set, model, extraction, mode, identity setting) of the grid (898 runs, all completed); the \vq{7} runs are \vq{7}'s own frozen grid and, for set~H, its held-out run. Pooled over models, extractions and modes; legacy scoring, plus strict scoring for set~H. Hand-identity check: in all 244 hand runs \vq{8} returned exactly \vq{7}'s fixes (244) and tier~2 items (244). Every number \vq{8} breaks on these sets is a hand-mode break that \vq{7} makes too, on the same cell with the same new value (OCR look-alike repairs on SEC sets 1--3, the Snap-on swap and the Salesforce cell, Section~\ref{sec:allmodels}); with discovered identities or zero-config \vq{8} breaks none. Source: \code{out/qcore8\_work/dev\_summary8.md}, \code{dev\_report8.md}, \code{dev\_report8.json}.
